verses.text: Di Lord speak to Moses and to Aaron, talk to dem,
“Speak to di pikin dem of Israel, talk, ‘Dem na di living things wey una fit eat among all di animals wey dey di earth.
Whatever divide di hoof, and be cloven footed, and chew di cud, among di animals, una fit eat am.
Nevertheless dem na dem wey una no go eat among dem wey chew di cud, or wey divide di hoof: di camel, because e chew di cud but no divide di hoof, e dey unclean to una.
Di rock hyrax, because e chew di cud but no divide di hoof, e dey unclean to una.
Di hare, because e chew di cud but no divide di hoof, e dey unclean to una.
Di pig, because e divide di hoof, and e cloven footed, but e no chew di cud, e dey unclean to una.
Una no go eat of dem flesh, and una no go touch dem carcass. Dem dey unclean to una.
Dem na wetin una fit eat of all wey dey di waters: whatever get fins and scales, for di waters, for di seas, and for di rivers, una fit eat am.
All wey no get fins and scales, for di seas, and for di rivers, of all wey swarm for di waters, and of all di living creatures wey dey di waters, dem na abomination to una,
and dem go be abomination to una. Una no go eat of dem flesh, and una go detest dem carcasses.
Whatever dey for di waters wey no get fins and scales, dat na abomination to una.
Dem na di ones wey una go detest among di birds. Dem no go dey eaten. Dem na abomination: di eagle, di vulture, di black vulture,
di red kite, any kind of black kite,
any kind of raven,
di ostrich, di owl, di seagull, any kind of hawk,
di little owl, di cormorant, di screech owl,
di white owl, di pelican, di carrion vulture,
di stork, any kind of heron, di hoopoe, and di bat.
All winged creeping things wey waka on all fours na abomination to una.
Yet dem na wetin una fit eat of every winged creeping thing wey go on all fours, wey get legs above dem feet, to leap with on di earth.
Of dem una fit eat dem: di locust after im kind, di bald locust after im kind, di cricket after im kind, and di grasshopper after im kind.
But all other winged creeping things wey get four feet na abomination to una.
By dem una go make yourselves unclean. Whoever touch dem carcass go dey unclean until evening.
Whoever carry any part of dem carcass go wash im clothes, and dey unclean until evening.
Every animal wey divide di hoof but no cloven footed, or no chew di cud, e dey unclean to una. Everyone wey touch dem go dey unclean.
Whatever go on im paws, among all di animals wey go on all fours, dem dey unclean to una. Whoever touch dem carcass go dey unclean until evening.
Di one wey carry dem carcass go wash im clothes, and dey unclean until evening. Dem dey unclean to una.
Dis na di unclean to una among di creeping things wey creep on di earth: di weasel, di mouse, any kind of large lizard,
di gecko, di monitor lizard, di wall lizard, di sand lizard, and di chameleon.
Dem na di unclean to una among all wey creep. Whoever touch dem, when dem dey dead, go dey unclean until evening.

Anything on wey any of dem fall, when dem dey dead, go dey unclean, whether na any vessel of wood, or clothing, or skin, or sack, whatever vessel wey dem use do work. E must dey put into water, and e go dey unclean until evening. After dat e go dey clean.
Every earthen vessel wey any of dem fall into, whatever dey inside am go dey unclean, and una go break am.
Any food wey una fit eat, wey water from dis vessel come on, go dey unclean. All drink wey una fit drink for every such vessel go dey unclean.
Everything on wey any part of dem carcass fall go dey unclean. Oven or cooking range go dey broken in pieces. Dem dey unclean, and go dey unclean to una.
Nevertheless one spring or one cistern wey collect water go dey clean, but di one wey touch dem carcass go dey unclean.
If any part of dem carcass fall on any seed wey dem dey sow, e dey clean.
But if water dey put on di seed, and any part of dem carcass fall on am, e dey unclean to una.
If any animal wey una fit eat die, di one wey touch di carcass of am go dey unclean until evening.
Di one wey eat of im carcass go wash im clothes, and dey unclean until evening. Di one wey carry di carcass go wash im clothes, and dey unclean until evening.
Every creeping thing wey creep on di earth na abomination. E no go dey eaten.
Whatever go on im belly, and whatever go on all fours, or whatever get many feet, even all creeping things wey creep on di earth, una no go eat dem, because dem na abomination.
Una no go make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing wey creep, neither una go make yourselves unclean with dem, so that una go dey defiled by dem.
Because I na di Lord una God. Una go make yourselves holy therefore, and una go dey holy, because I dey holy. Neither una go defile yourselves with any kind of creeping thing wey creep on di earth.
Because I na di Lord wey bring una up out of di land of Egypt, to be una God. Una go dey holy, because I dey holy.’”
Dis na di law of di animal, and of di bird, and of every living creature wey move for di waters, and of every creature wey creep on di earth,
to make difference between di unclean and di clean, and between di living creature wey dem fit eat and di living creature wey dem no go eat.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to di pikin dem of Israel, talk, ‘If one woman become pregnant, and born one pikin man, di woman go dey unclean seven days. As for di days of im impurity for im period, e go dey unclean.
For di eighth day di flesh of di boy foreskin go dey circumcised.
Di woman go continue 33 days for di blood of purifying. E no go touch any holy thing, nor come into di sanctuary, until di days of im purifying don complete.
But if e born one pikin woman, e go dey unclean two weeks, as for im impurity, and e go continue 66 days for di blood of purifying.

When di days of im purifying dey fulfilled, for pikin man or for pikin woman, e go bring one lamb of one year old for burnt offering, and one young pigeon or one turtledove, for sin offering, to di door of di Tent of Meeting, to di priest.
E go offer am before di Lord, and make atonement for am. Di flow of im blood go dey cleansed. Dis na di law for am wey born, whether male or female.

If im means no reach to bring one lamb, e go take two turtledoves or two young pigeons, one for burnt offering, and di other for sin offering. Di priest go make atonement for am, and e go dey clean.’”
Di Lord speak to Moses and Aaron, talk,

“When one man get for di skin of im flesh one swelling, or one scab, or one bright spot, and e become di plague of leprosy for di skin of im flesh, dem go bring am to Aaron di priest, or to one of im pikin man dem di priests.

Di priest go examine di plague for di skin of di flesh. If di hair for di plague don turn white, and di appearance of di plague dey deeper pass di skin of im flesh, e na di plague of leprosy. Di priest go examine am, and pronounce am unclean.
If di bright spot dey white for di skin of im flesh, and im appearance no deeper pass di skin, and im hair no turn white, di priest go shut up di one wey get di plague seven days.
Di priest go examine am di seventh day. If, look, for im eyes di plague don stay, and di plague no spread for di skin, di priest go shut am up seven days more.
Di priest go examine am again di seventh day. If, look, di plague don fade, and di plague no spread for di skin, di priest go pronounce am clean. E na scab. E go wash im clothes, and dey clean.
But if di scab spread much for di skin, after e don show imself to di priest for im cleansing, e go show imself to di priest again.
Di priest go examine am. If, look, di scab spread for di skin, di priest go pronounce am unclean. E na leprosy.
When di plague of leprosy dey for one man, dem go bring am to di priest.
Di priest go examine am. If, look, di swelling white for di skin, and e don turn di hair white, and raw flesh dey for di swelling,
e na one old leprosy for di skin of im flesh, and di priest go pronounce am unclean. E no go shut am up, because e dey unclean.
If leprosy break out abroad for di skin, and di leprosy cover all di skin of am wey get di plague from im head even to im feet, as far as di priest see,
di priest go examine am. If, look, di leprosy don cover all im flesh, e go pronounce di one wey get di plague clean. E don turn all white. E dey clean.
But di day wey raw flesh show for am, e go dey unclean.
Di priest go examine di raw flesh, and pronounce am unclean. Di raw flesh dey unclean. E na leprosy.
Or if di raw flesh turn again, and e dey changed to white, e go come to di priest,
and di priest go examine am. If, look, di plague don turn white, di priest go pronounce di one wey get di plague clean. E dey clean.
When di flesh get one boil for im skin, and e dey healed,
and for di place of di boil dere dey one white swelling, or one bright spot, reddish white, e go dey shown to di priest.
Di priest go examine am. If, look, im appearance dey deeper pass di skin, and im hair don turn white, di priest go pronounce am unclean. E na plague of leprosy. E don break out for di boil.
But if di priest examine am, and look, no white hairs dey for am, and e no deeper pass di skin, but e don fade, di priest go shut am up seven days.
If e spread much abroad for di skin, di priest go pronounce am unclean. E na plague.
But if di bright spot stay for im place, and no spread, e na scar of di boil. Di priest go pronounce am clean.
Or when di flesh get for di skin of am one burn by fire, and di raw flesh of di burn become one bright spot, reddish white, or white,

di priest go examine am. If, look, di hair for di bright spot don turn white, and im appearance dey deeper pass di skin, e na leprosy. E don break out for di burn. Di priest go pronounce am unclean. E na plague of leprosy.
But if di priest examine am, and look, no white hair dey for di bright spot, and e no deeper pass di skin, but e don fade, di priest go shut am up seven days.
Di priest go examine am di seventh day. If e spread much abroad for di skin, di priest go pronounce am unclean. E na plague of leprosy.
If di bright spot stay for im place, and no spread for di skin, but e don fade, e na swelling from di burn. Di priest go pronounce am clean, because e na scar from di burn.
When one man or woman get one plague on di head or on di beard,

di priest go examine di plague. If, look, im appearance dey deeper pass di skin, and e get thin yellow hair for am, di priest go pronounce am unclean. E na itch. E na leprosy of di head or of di beard.
If di priest examine di plague of di itch, and look, im appearance no deeper pass di skin, and no black hair dey for am, di priest go shut up di one wey get di plague of itch seven days.
For di seventh day di priest go examine di plague. If, look, di itch no spread, and no yellow hair dey for am, and di appearance of di itch no deeper pass di skin,
e go shave imself, but di itch e no go shave. Di priest go shut up di one wey get di itch seven days more.
For di seventh day di priest go examine di itch. If, look, di itch no spread for di skin, and e no deeper pass di skin, di priest go pronounce am clean. E go wash im clothes, and dey clean.
But if di itch spread much for di skin after im cleansing,
di priest go examine am. If, look, di itch don spread for di skin, di priest no go look for yellow hair. E dey unclean.
But if for im eyes di itch don stay, and black hair don grow for am, di itch dey healed. E dey clean. Di priest go pronounce am clean.
When one man or woman get bright spots for di skin of di flesh, even white bright spots,
di priest go look. If, look, di bright spots for di skin of di flesh dey dull white, e na tetter wey don break out for di skin. E dey clean.
If one man lose im hair from im head, e dey bald, but e dey clean.
If e lose im hair from di front part of im head, e dey bald for di forehead, but e dey clean.
But if dere dey for di bald head or di bald forehead one reddish white plague, e na leprosy breaking out for im bald head or im bald forehead.
Di priest go examine am. If, look, di swelling of di plague reddish white for im bald head or for im bald forehead, as di appearance of leprosy for di skin of di flesh,
e na leprous man. E dey unclean. Di priest go surely pronounce am unclean. E get im plague for im head.
Di leper wey get di plague, im clothes go dey torn, and im head go dey bare, and e go cover im upper lip, and e go cry, ‘Unclean! Unclean!’
All di days wey di plague dey for am e go dey unclean. E dey unclean. E go dwell alone. Im dwelling go be outside di camp.
Di garment also wey di plague of leprosy dey inside, whether na woolen garment, or linen garment,
whether for warp or woof, of linen or of wool, whether for leather, or for anything wey dem make of leather,
if di plague dey greenish or reddish for di garment, or for di leather, or for di warp, or for di woof, or for anything of leather, e na plague of leprosy, and e go dey shown to di priest.
Di priest go examine di plague, and shut up di thing wey get di plague seven days.

E go examine di plague di seventh day. If di plague don spread for di garment, or for di warp, or for di woof, or for di leather, whatever use dem make di leather for, di plague na one malignant leprosy. E dey unclean.
E go burn di garment, whether warp or woof, of wool or of linen, or anything of leather, wey di plague dey inside, because e na malignant leprosy. E go dey burnt for di fire.
If di priest examine, and look, di plague no spread for di garment, either for di warp, or for di woof, or for anything of leather,
di priest go command say dem go wash di thing wey di plague dey inside, and e go shut am up seven days more.

Di priest go examine di plague after dem don wash am. If, look, di plague no change im appearance, and di plague no spread, e dey unclean. Una go burn am for di fire. E na mildew, whether e dey bare for im inside or im outside.
If di priest examine, and look, di plague don fade after dem wash am, e go tear am out of di garment, or out of di leather, or out of di warp, or out of di woof.
If e still show for di garment, either for di warp, or for di woof, or for anything of leather, e dey break out. Una go burn with fire wetin di plague dey inside.
Di garment, either warp or woof, or anything of leather, wey una don wash, if di plague don depart from dem, e go dey washed di second time, and e go dey clean.”
Dis na di law of di plague of leprosy for woolen or linen garment, either warp or woof, or anything of leather, to pronounce am clean, or to pronounce am unclean.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Dis go be di law of di leper for di day of im cleansing: e go dey brought to di priest,
and di priest go go out of di camp. Di priest go examine am. If, look, di plague of leprosy don heal for di leper,
di priest go command say dem go take two living clean birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop, for di one wey dem go cleanse.
Di priest go command say dem go kill one of di birds over running water for one earthen vessel.
As for di living bird, e go take am, with di cedar wood, and di scarlet, and di hyssop, and go dip dem and di living bird for di blood of di bird wey dem kill over di running water.
E go sprinkle am seven times on am wey go dey cleansed from di leprosy, and go pronounce am clean, and go let di living bird loose into di open field.
Im wey go dey cleansed go wash im clothes, and shave off all im hair, and bathe imself in water, and e go dey clean. After dat e go come into di camp, but e go stay outside im tent seven days.

E go come be say on di seventh day, say e go shave all im hair off im head, and im beard, and im eyebrows, even all im hair e go shave off. E go wash im clothes, and e go bathe im flesh in water, and e go dey clean.

For di eighth day e go take two male lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of one year old without blemish, and three tenths of one ephah of fine flour for one meal offering, mixed with oil, and one log of oil.
Di priest wey cleanse am go present di man wey go dey cleansed, and dem things, before di Lord, at di door of di Tent of Meeting.
Di priest go take one of di male lambs, and offer am for one trespass offering, with di log of oil, and wave dem for wave offering before di Lord.
E go kill di male lamb for di place wia dem dey kill di sin offering and di burnt offering, for di holy place, because as di sin offering na di priest own, so di trespass offering. E na most holy.

Di priest go take some of di blood of di trespass offering, and di priest go put am on di tip of di right ear of am wey go dey cleansed, and on di thumb of im right hand, and on di big toe of im right foot.
Di priest go take some of di log of oil, and pour am into di palm of im own left hand.
Di priest go dip im right finger for di oil wey dey im left hand, and go sprinkle some of di oil with im finger seven times before di Lord.

Di priest go put some of di rest of di oil wey dey im hand on di tip of di right ear of am wey go dey cleansed, and on di thumb of im right hand, and on di big toe of im right foot, on top of di blood of di trespass offering.
Di rest of di oil wey dey di priest hand e go put on di head of am wey go dey cleansed. Di priest go make atonement for am before di Lord.
Di priest go offer di sin offering, and make atonement for am wey go dey cleansed from im uncleanness. After dat e go kill di burnt offering.
Di priest go offer di burnt offering and di meal offering on di altar. Di priest go make atonement for am, and e go dey clean.

If e dey poor, and im means no reach, e go take one male lamb for one trespass offering to dey waved, to make atonement for am, and one tenth of one ephah of fine flour mixed with oil for one meal offering, and one log of oil,
and two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as im means fit reach. One go be sin offering, and di other burnt offering.
For di eighth day e go bring dem for im cleansing to di priest, to di door of di Tent of Meeting, before di Lord.
Di priest go take di lamb of di trespass offering, and di log of oil, and di priest go wave dem for wave offering before di Lord.

E go kill di lamb of di trespass offering. Di priest go take some of di blood of di trespass offering, and put am on di tip of di right ear of am wey go dey cleansed, and on di thumb of im right hand, and on di big toe of im right foot.
Di priest go pour some of di oil into di palm of im own left hand.
Di priest go sprinkle with im right finger some of di oil wey dey im left hand seven times before di Lord.

Di priest go put some of di oil wey dey im hand on di tip of di right ear of am wey go dey cleansed, and on di thumb of im right hand, and on di big toe of im right foot, upon di place of di blood of di trespass offering.
Di rest of di oil wey dey di priest hand e go put on di head of am wey go dey cleansed, to make atonement for am before di Lord.
E go offer one of di turtledoves, or of di young pigeons, such as im means fit reach,
even such as im means fit reach, one for sin offering, and di other for burnt offering, with di meal offering. Di priest go make atonement before di Lord for am wey go dey cleansed.
Dis na di law for am wey get di plague of leprosy, wey im means no reach for im cleansing.”
Di Lord speak to Moses and to Aaron, talk,
“When una come into di land of Canaan, wey I give una for possession, and I put di plague of mildew for one house of di land of una possession,
im wey own di house go come and tell di priest, talk, ‘E seem to me say plague dey for di house.’
Di priest go command say dem go empty di house, before di priest go in to see di plague, so that all wey dey for di house no go dey unclean. After dat di priest go go in to see di house.
E go examine di plague. If, look, di plague dey for di walls of di house with hollow streaks, greenish or reddish, and im appearance dey lower pass di wall,
di priest go go out of di house to di door of di house, and shut up di house seven days.
Di priest go return di seventh day, and examine am. If, look, di plague don spread for di walls of di house,
di priest go command say dem go take out di stones wey di plague dey inside, and dem go cast dem into one unclean place outside di city.
E go cause di house to dey scraped inside all round, and dem go pour out di plaster wey dem scrape off outside di city into one unclean place.
Dem go take other stones, and put dem in di place of dem stones, and e go take other plaster, and plaster di house.
If di plague come again, and break out for di house, after e don take out di stones, and after e don scrape di house, and after e don plaster,
di priest go come and examine. If, look, di plague don spread for di house, e na malignant mildew for di house. E dey unclean.
E go break down di house, im stones, and im timber, and all di plaster of di house, and e go carry dem out of di city to one unclean place.
Moreover im wey go into di house all di days wey e shut am up go dey unclean until evening.
Im wey lie down for di house go wash im clothes. Im wey eat for di house go wash im clothes.
If di priest come in, and examine am, and look, di plague no spread for di house after di house don dey plastered, di priest go pronounce di house clean, because di plague don heal.
E go take to cleanse di house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop.
E go kill one of di birds over running water for one earthen vessel.
E go take di cedar wood, and di hyssop, and di scarlet, and di living bird, and dip dem for di blood of di bird wey dem kill, and for di running water, and sprinkle di house seven times.
E go cleanse di house with di blood of di bird, and with di running water, and with di living bird, and with di cedar wood, and with di hyssop, and with di scarlet.
But e go let di living bird loose outside di city into di open field. Na so e go make atonement for di house, and e go dey clean.”
Dis na di law for every plague of leprosy, and for di itch,
and for di leprosy of one garment, and of one house,
and for one swelling, and for one scab, and for one bright spot,
to teach when e dey unclean, and when e dey clean. Dis na di law of leprosy.
Di Lord speak to Moses and to Aaron, talk,
“Speak to di pikin dem of Israel, and talk to dem, ‘When any man get one discharge from im body, im discharge dey unclean.
Dis go be im uncleanness for im discharge: whether im body run with im discharge, or im body dey stopped from im discharge, e na uncleanness for am.
Every bed wey di one wey get di discharge lie on go dey unclean, and everything wey e sit on go dey unclean.
Whoever touch im bed go wash im clothes, and bathe imself in water, and dey unclean until evening.
Im wey sit on anything wey di one wey get di discharge sit on go wash im clothes, and bathe imself in water, and dey unclean until evening.
Im wey touch di body of di one wey get di discharge go wash im clothes, and bathe imself in water, and dey unclean until evening.
If im wey get di discharge spit on one clean person, di person go wash im clothes, and bathe imself in water, and dey unclean until evening.
Whatever saddle wey im wey get di discharge ride on go dey unclean.
Whoever touch anything wey dey under am go dey unclean until evening. Im wey carry any of dem things go wash im clothes, and bathe imself in water, and dey unclean until evening.
Whoever di one wey get di discharge touch, without e don rinse im hands in water, go wash im clothes, and bathe imself in water, and dey unclean until evening.
Di earthen vessel, wey im wey get di discharge touch, go dey broken, and every vessel of wood go dey rinsed in water.
When im wey get di discharge dey cleansed of im discharge, e go count for imself seven days for im cleansing, and wash im clothes. E go bathe im flesh in running water, and e go dey clean.
For di eighth day e go take for imself two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before di Lord to di door of di Tent of Meeting, and give dem to di priest.
Di priest go offer dem, one for sin offering, and di other for burnt offering. Di priest go make atonement for am before di Lord for im discharge.
If any man get one emission of semen, e go bathe all im flesh in water, and dey unclean until evening.
Every garment, and every skin, wey di semen dey on, go dey washed with water, and dey unclean until evening.
Di woman with wey man lie with semen, di two of dem go bathe demself in water, and dey unclean until evening.
If one woman get one discharge, and di discharge for im flesh na blood, di woman go dey for im impurity seven days. Whoever touch di woman go dey unclean until evening.
Everything wey di woman lie on for im impurity go dey unclean. Everything wey di woman sit on go dey unclean.
Whoever touch di woman bed go wash im clothes, and bathe imself in water, and dey unclean until evening.
Whoever touch anything wey di woman sit on go wash im clothes, and bathe imself in water, and dey unclean until evening.
If e dey on di bed, or on anything wey di woman dey sit on, when e touch am, e go dey unclean until evening.
If any man lie with di woman, and di woman impurity dey on am, e go dey unclean seven days. Every bed wey e lie on go dey unclean.

If one woman get one discharge of im blood many days, not for di time of im impurity, or if di woman get one discharge beyond di time of im impurity, all di days of di discharge of im uncleanness e go dey as for di days of im impurity. E dey unclean.
Every bed wey di woman lie on all di days of im discharge go dey to am as di bed of im impurity. Everything wey di woman sit on go dey unclean, as di uncleanness of im impurity.
Whoever touch dem things go dey unclean, and go wash im clothes, and bathe imself in water, and dey unclean until evening.
But if di woman dey cleansed of im discharge, e go count for imself seven days, and after dat e go dey clean.
For di eighth day e go take for imself two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and bring dem to di priest, to di door of di Tent of Meeting.
Di priest go offer one for sin offering, and di other for burnt offering. Di priest go make atonement for am before di Lord for di discharge of im uncleanness.
Na so una go separate di pikin dem of Israel from dem uncleanness, so that dem no go die for dem uncleanness, when dem defile my tabernacle wey dey among dem.’”
Dis na di law of am wey get one discharge, and of am whose semen go out, so that e dey unclean by am,
and of am wey dey sick with im impurity, and of am wey get one discharge, whether male or female, and of am wey lie with one woman wey dey unclean.
Di Lord speak to Moses after di death of Aaron two pikin man dem, when dem come near before di Lord, and die.

Di Lord talk to Moses, “Speak to Aaron your brother, say make e no come at all times into di holy place inside di veil, before di mercy seat wey dey on di ark, so that e no go die, because I go appear for di cloud on di mercy seat.
Aaron go come into di holy place with dis: with one young bull for sin offering, and one ram for burnt offering.

E go put on di holy linen coat, and e go get di linen trousers on im body, and e go gird imself with di linen sash, and with di linen turban e go dey attired. Dem na di holy garments. E go bathe im flesh in water, and put dem on.
E go take from di congregation of di pikin dem of Israel two male goats for sin offering, and one ram for burnt offering.
Aaron go offer im bull of di sin offering, wey be im own, and make atonement for imself and for im house.
E go take di two goats, and present dem before di Lord at di door of di Tent of Meeting.
Aaron go cast lots for di two goats: one lot for di Lord, and di other lot for Azazel.
Aaron go present di goat on wey di lot for di Lord fall, and offer am for sin offering.
But di goat on wey di lot for Azazel fall go dey presented alive before di Lord, to make atonement for am, to send am away for Azazel into di wilderness.
Aaron go present di bull of di sin offering, wey be im own, and go make atonement for imself and for im house, and e go kill di bull of di sin offering wey be im own.
E go take one censer full of coals of fire from off di altar before di Lord, and im hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring am inside di veil.
E go put di incense on di fire before di Lord, so that di cloud of di incense go cover di mercy seat wey dey on di testimony, so that e no go die.
E go take some of di blood of di bull, and sprinkle am with im finger on di mercy seat on di east. Before di mercy seat e go sprinkle some of di blood with im finger seven times.

After dat e go kill di goat of di sin offering wey be for di people, and bring im blood inside di veil, and do with im blood as e do with di blood of di bull, and sprinkle am on di mercy seat, and before di mercy seat.

E go make atonement for di holy place, because of di uncleanness of di pikin dem of Israel, and because of dem transgressions, even all dem sins. Na so e go do for di Tent of Meeting, wey dey among dem for di middle of dem uncleanness.
No man go dey for di Tent of Meeting when e go in to make atonement for di holy place, until e come out. E go make atonement for imself, and for im household, and for all di assembly of Israel.
E go go out to di altar wey dey before di Lord, and make atonement for am, and take some of di blood of di bull, and some of di blood of di goat, and put am on di horns of di altar round about.
E go sprinkle some of di blood on am with im finger seven times, and cleanse am, and make am holy from di uncleanness of di pikin dem of Israel.
When e don finish making atonement for di holy place, and di Tent of Meeting, and di altar, e go present di living goat.

Aaron go lay both im hands on di head of di living goat, and confess over am all di iniquities of di pikin dem of Israel, and all dem transgressions, even all dem sins. E go put dem on di head of di goat, and go send am away by di hand of one man wey dey ready into di wilderness.
Di goat go bear on am all dem iniquities to one solitary land. E go let di goat go for di wilderness.
Aaron go come into di Tent of Meeting, and go take off di linen garments, wey e put on when e go into di holy place, and go leave dem dere.
E go bathe im flesh in water for one holy place, and put on im garments, and come out, and offer im burnt offering and di burnt offering of di people, and make atonement for imself and for di people.
Di fat of di sin offering e go burn on di altar.
Im wey let go di goat for Azazel go wash im clothes, and bathe im flesh in water. After dat e go come into di camp.

Di bull of di sin offering, and di goat of di sin offering, wey dem bring in dem blood to make atonement for di holy place, dem go carry dem outside di camp. Dem go burn with fire dem skins, and dem flesh, and dem dung.
Im wey burn dem go wash im clothes, and bathe im flesh in water. After dat e go come into di camp.

Dis go be one statute forever to una: for di seventh month, on di tenth day of di month, una go afflict una souls, and una go do no kind of work, whether di native, or di stranger wey dey dwell among una,
because on dis day e go make atonement for una, to cleanse una. Una go dey clean from all una sins before di Lord.
E go be one Sabbath of solemn rest to una, and una go afflict una souls. E na one statute forever.
Di priest wey dem go anoint and wey dem go set apart to minister for di priest office for im papa place go make di atonement, and go put on di linen garments, di holy garments.
After dat e go make atonement for di most holy place, and e go make atonement for di Tent of Meeting and for di altar. E go make atonement for di priests and for all di people of di assembly.
Dis go be one everlasting statute for una, to make atonement for di pikin dem of Israel because of all dem sins once for di year.” E do as di Lord command Moses.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to Aaron, and to im pikin man dem, and to all di pikin dem of Israel, and tell dem, ‘Dis na di thing wey di Lord don command:
Any man of di house of Israel wey kill one ox, or lamb, or goat, for di camp, or wey kill am outside di camp,

and no bring am to di door of di Tent of Meeting, to offer am as one offering to di Lord before di tabernacle of di Lord, blood-guilt go dey counted to dat man. E don shed blood. Dat man go dey cut off from among im people.

Dis na so that di pikin dem of Israel go bring dem sacrifices, wey dem dey offer for di open field, so that dem go bring dem to di Lord, to di door of di Tent of Meeting, to di priest, and offer dem for sacrifices of peace offerings to di Lord.
Di priest go sprinkle di blood on di altar of di Lord at di door of di Tent of Meeting, and burn di fat for pleasing aroma to di Lord.
Dem no go sacrifice dem sacrifices again to goat demons, wey dem dey prostitute after. Dis go be one statute forever to dem throughout dem generations.
Talk to dem say: Any man of di house of Israel, or of di strangers wey dey dwell among una, wey offer one burnt offering or sacrifice,
and no bring am to di door of di Tent of Meeting, to offer am to di Lord, dat man go dey cut off from im people.
Any man of di house of Israel, or of di strangers wey dey dwell among dem, wey eat any kind of blood, I go set my face against di soul wey eat blood, and I go cut am off from among im people.
Because di life of di flesh dey for di blood. I don give am to una on di altar to make atonement for una souls, because na di blood wey dey make atonement by reason of di life.
Na why I talk to di pikin dem of Israel say no soul of una go eat blood, and say di stranger wey dey dwell among una no go eat blood.
Any man of di pikin dem of Israel, or of di strangers wey dey dwell among dem, wey hunt and catch any animal or bird wey dem fit eat, e go pour out im blood, and cover am with dust.

Because as for di life of all flesh, im blood na im life. Na why I talk to di pikin dem of Israel say dem no go eat di blood of any kind of flesh, because di life of all flesh na im blood, and whoever eat am go dey cut off.

Every person wey eat wetin die of itself, or wetin animals tear, whether e be native or stranger, go wash im clothes, and bathe imself in water, and dey unclean until evening. After dat e go dey clean.
But if e no wash dem, nor bathe im flesh, e go bear im iniquity.’”
